t: You're at Chelsea Old Church, also called All Saints, a Grade I listed Anglican church on Old Church Street, near Albert Bridge. A small public garden to the west holds a sculpture by Sir Jacob Epstein. Inside, a plaque remembers Henry James, who lived nearby on Cheyne Walk. Several notable people are buried here. Thomas More, author of Utopia and Henry VIII's Lord Chancellor. Sir Hans Sloane, whose collection founded the British Museum. Elizabeth Blackwell, who drew and engraved A Curious Herbal. And Sir John Fielding, the blind magistrate and social reformer.
